body.message:
We can see that you have completed the check-in form. The only remaining step is to complete the security deposit in order to finalize your check-in process.

Please note that a security deposit of AED 2,000 is required upon check-in.

You may complete the payment using the following link:

https://totalpay.ae/payment/202603231969c0cb7795e3b

This amount is fully refundable at check-out, provided there are no damages to the apartment. The refund will be processed within 7 working days after your departure.
